{{Conjecture|legends}}
A green lizard was seen clinging to a tree branch tree when the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Lumpawaroo/Legends|Lumpawarrump]] used a rope ladder to descend to the lower levels of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] in search of Wasaka berries. The main part of its body was green, and it had a blue head, a blue spike on its tail, a small blue strip on its lower body, and a large yellow fin on its back.<ref name="The Wookiee Storybook">''[[The Wookiee Storybook]]''</ref>
